annotation.evidence_span: larger Push ID than the client has advertised
annotation.interpretation_a: The client advertised a maximum Push ID in a MAX_PUSH_ID frame. Any PUSH_PROMISE with a Push ID exceeding that value is an error.
annotation.interpretation_b: The client advertised a maximum Push ID. A PUSH_PROMISE is considered to have a 'larger' Push ID if it exceeds the advertised maximum, but also if it equals the advertised maximum. This is because the advertised maximum is exclusive.
annotation.justification: The clause states "larger Push ID", which is ambiguous. Does 'larger' mean strictly greater than, or greater than or equal to? The difference affects implementation, as a client might treat a Push ID equal to the advertised maximum differently.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the advertised maximum Push ID is inclusive or exclusive. This affects whether a PUSH_PROMISE with a Push ID equal to the advertised maximum is considered an error.
